rules.accepted_credit_types: Category A (min 15): programs by accredited/identified sponsors per 20 CSR 2235-7.005, postgraduate courses (1 credit = 15 CE), professional papers/publications, graduate teaching (max 10). Category B (max 25): professional meetings (3 h/day), non-accredited workshops/grand rounds, undergraduate teaching (max 9), individual study
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed mid-cycle: pro-rata reduction of 5 hours for every 3 full months between licensure and the normal start of the cycle.
rules.carryover: Category A credits above 40 may carry over to the next cycle, up to 15 hours.
rules.audit_note: Attest compliance on the biennial renewal form; keep records 4 years after each cycle; Committee may audit.
rules.notes: CE cycle Dec 1 of an odd year to Nov 30 of the next odd year. 3 ethics credits may be Category A or B. Separately, 2 h of suicide assessment/referral/treatment/management training is a condition of initial licensure (section 337.718 RSMo), not renewal.
